subject: Your Mercday Pro plan renews soon
body: Thanks for running your guild on Mercday Pro.\nYour plan renews on {date} for {amount} notes. No action is needed; the fee is added to your end of month expenses.

subject: Thank you for your service
body: Your team completed Contract 14 Name ahead of schedule. Our board was impressed.\nWe will send your guild the first look at our next posting.

subject: An invitation to the harvest banquet
body: My household hosts a banquet at the end of the month and your guild is invited.\nGuests usually bring a gift for the host.

subject: Re: An invitation to the harvest banquet
body: Wonderful. Your seat is reserved at the head table.

subject: Re: An invitation to the harvest banquet
body: A pity. Perhaps next year.

subject: Bandits on the north road
body: Our watch reports bandits camped along the north road. We may post a contract to clear them out.\nWould your guild be interested?

subject: Re: Bandits on the north road
body: Good. Watch the contract board; the posting will go up within the week.

subject: Re: Bandits on the north road
body: Understood. We will ask another guild.

subject: Vacation request
body: I would like to take {vac_days} days off, from {vac_start} to {vac_end}. My family is visiting from Copari.

subject: Re: Vacation request
body: Thank you! I will be back on {vac_end}.

subject: Re: Vacation request
body: Understood. I will stay.

subject: Re: Vacation request
body: {vac_start} to {vac_end} works for me. Thank you.

subject: A short break after Contract 6 Name
body: When I return from Contract 6 Name, could I take {vac_days} days to rest? From {vac_start} to {vac_end}.

subject: Re: A short break after Contract 6 Name
body: Much appreciated.

subject: Re: A short break after Contract 6 Name
body: Fine. I will report in when I am back.

subject: About the fee on our next contract
body: We have hired your guild many times. Would you lower the fee on our next contract by 10%?

subject: Re: About the fee on our next contract
body: Thank you. We will post the contract soon.

subject: Re: About the fee on our next contract
body: That is disappointing.

subject: Re: About the fee on our next contract
body: 5% is acceptable. We have a deal.

subject: Family emergency
body: My father has fallen ill. I need {vac_days} days, starting {vac_start}. I know it is short notice.

subject: Re: Family emergency
body: Thank you. I will not forget this.

subject: Re: Family emergency
body: I see.

subject: Guild Hall rent, Month 8
body: Rent for Month 8 is {amount} notes, due {date}.

subject: Reminder: rent due {date}
body: This is a reminder that {amount} notes are due on {date}.

subject: Payment received
body: Received {amount} notes for Month 8. Thank you.

subject: Invoice: Mercday Pro, Month 7
body: Your Month 7 invoice was paid with your end of month expenses.

subject: Treatment fees for FirstName3 LastName3
body: FirstName3 LastName3 was treated for wounds after their last contract. The fee is {amount} notes, due {date}.

subject: Re: Treatment fees for FirstName3 LastName3
body: We reviewed the charge and reduced it to {amount} notes. The new due date is {date}.

subject: Guild license renewal
body: Your guild license expires soon. The renewal fee is {amount} notes, due {date}. Unlicensed guilds cannot accept new contracts.

subject: Reminder: guild license renewal
body: Your renewal fee of {amount} notes is due {date}.

subject: License renewed
body: Your guild license is renewed for another year.

subject: Company 4 Name to report earnings
body: Company 4 Name will report quarterly earnings on {date}. Analysts expect strong results after a busy contract season.

subject: Dividend day approaches
body: Companies pay their quarterly dividends on {date}. Shareholders are paid automatically.

subject: Storms close the Gledd Sea crossing
body: Ships are staying in port until the storms pass. Contracts that cross the Gledd Sea may take longer than usual.

subject: Guild rankings, Month 7
body: Your guild placed 14th of 60 registered guilds in Month 7, up 3 places.

subject: YOU HAVE WON 10,000 NOTES!!!
body: Congratulations! Your guild was selected to receive 10,000 notes. Claim your prize today.

subject: Re: Your prize, one small fee
body: To release your prize, please send a processing fee of 50 notes.

subject: Re: Your prize is processing
body: Your fee was received. Please allow 6 to 8 years for delivery.

subject: Discreet goods, no questions asked
body: Lockpicks. Permits. Things that fall off carts. A friend of a friend says you might be interested.

subject: Re: Discreet goods
body: Not by mail. A friend will find you.

subject: Exclusive offer for valued guilds!
body: For a limited time, valued guilds receive 2% off select Company 8 Name services. Terms apply.

subject: You have been unsubscribed
body: You have been removed from 1 of our 14 mailing lists.

subject: Urgent help needed from royalty
body: A member of the royal court of Umbra is stranded abroad and needs 200 notes to return home. You will be repaid tenfold.

subject: Undeliverable
body: This address no longer exists.
